_note: PRE-FLIGHT for the run series (~15-20 min). Run this before every long run: it exercises the two-tier poller, the density logger, the serial path and the txdbm path end to end, so a night is never lost to a broken rig. Its timings are DELIBERATELY compressed and are the one place the series' standard instrument block does not apply -- a short fast_timeout_s (120s) hands still-unseen keys to the slow tier, which re-sweeps every 300s (production: 900s) so the slow tier exercises inside a short run. Confirm afterwards: detection.csv holds fast-tier hits with first_fetched_at (propagation), deliverability.csv holds any slow-tier hits with swept_at and no first_fetched_at, and analyze deliverability is the union of the two while propagation stays detection-only. Cell a000_ref is the series ANCHOR condition and should come back 20/20 -- if it does not, the rig or the site is off before you commit a night to it. Ground truth: resweep.py results/<run>.
